hotels.title: Gold Coast Five-Star Sanctuary Cove Retreat with One-Acre Lagoon Beach Pool
hotels.description: Fall in love with the Gold Coast's laidback atmosphere at InterContinental Sanctuary Cove Resort, an IHG Hotel. This idyllic hideaway is superbly set on 4.2-hectares of tropical gardens and boasts a sprawling one-acre lagoon pool and four exquisite dining destinations. The world-renowned Gold Coast theme parks are just a 10-minute drive away, and guests can also enjoy easy access to the tranquil Marine Village or critically-acclaimed golf course.

hotels.title: Sanctuary Cove Icon: Gold Coast Haven with A$100 Dining Credit & Unlimited Dreamworld Entry
hotels.description: Fall in love with the Gold Coast’s laid-back atmosphere at this five-star Sanctuary Cove reprieve. This idyllic hideaway is superbly set across more than nine acres of tropical gardens, boasting a sprawling one-acre lagoon pool so you can soak up the tropics from every luxurious angle. Dining at this resort is defined by multiple unique culinary experiences. Savour the flavours of wood-fired fare in rustic-chic surrounds at The Fireplace, then dive into a whiskey tasting at the lively Verandah Restaurant & Bar. Treat yourself to high tea or elevate your poolside relaxation with refreshing cocktails and poke bowls influenced by local flavours. With unlimited access to Dreamworld and WhiteWater World (seasonal), you and the crew can come and go as you please, choosing between rollercoasters and full-throttle waterslides. You’ll also score unlimited entry to the SkyPoint Observation Deck, perched on Level 77 of the iconic Q1 building, where views stretch from skyline to the sea and lush hinterland.
